newsitem.title: USA: Executive Telecard names Jensen chairman.
newsitem.headline: Executive Telecard names Jensen chairman.

text.p: Executive TeleCard Friday said it named principal shareholder Ronald Jensen chairman, succeeding Edward J. Gerrity, who remains on the board as a director.
Jensen, who is also chairman of UICI, joined the Executive TeleCard Board in June, after investing $7.6 million for restricted Executive TeleCard common stock.
Executive TeleCard also said it named Arthur H. Fredston, a partner in the New York law offices of Winthrop, Stimson, Putnam & Roberts, to the Board.

Other board changes were the resignation of Stig Sonnerberg and Ebrahim Ali Abdul Aal, bringing the number of directors from eight to seven. Both of the resigning Board members have been elected to a company management committee.
Executive TeleCard is an international telecommunications service company.
